_meta.rationale: Apple's SF Pro maps to Inter in BRAND_FONT_REGISTRY. Follows the same .a-button selector pattern as the three Phase 5 first-tuple specs (aeon_buttons, openai_buttons, stripe_buttons); identical assertion shape preserved so the four buttons specs are mutually consistent. Negative assertion uses the apple strip-target set.
gaps: Apple is not in fidelity_targets.yml; gate will report MISSING_REFERENCE for apple/buttons tuples until captures land.
No palette or spacing assertion; the three sibling buttons specs do not carry one either (same source-of-truth gap).

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.a-button'); if (!el) return false; return (el.textContent || '').toLowerCase().includes('apple'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['apple.com/logo', 'apple-logo', '/ac-globalnav/svg/logo', 'apple.svg', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const el = document.querySelector('.b-btn--primary, .a-btn'); if (!el) return true; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()
